Resolves #21987

The placement tests activate the Popover button with Space while the pointer stays clear of it. The native action opens the popover without a competing hover event. The test still checks every alignment and the fallback when a side has too little space.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium on the real example) → L3 required (placement and constrained-side flip).

Micro-review eligible: mechanical — one browser spec uses a stable input path for the same geometry checks.

CI jobs: +0.

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. Prescription checked against `test/playwright/e2e/popover/Placement.spec.mjs`: this spec owns the activation that precedes each geometry assertion.

## Test Evidence

I reproduced the ordering in the real demo. Mouseover opened the popover before the click, and the native click closed it. With keyboard activation, the repo's named Chromium run passed 12 repetitions of all three cases (36/36). `git diff --check` passed.
